title: Kambang Iwak Fest 2026 Mulai Hari Ini: Jumat Sore Lomba Fashion Show Wastra
hook: Kambang Iwak Fest mulai hari ini di Palembang dan Jumat sore jam tigo ado lomba fashion show wastra.
story: Dinda berdiri di trotoar tepi Kambang Iwak Palembang pada pagi hari, di belakangnya tampak tenda festival kuliner dan panggung kecil yang sedang disiapkan. Ia menyapa penonton, menyebut Kambang Iwak Fest 2026 digelar 26 sampai 28 November di pelataran depan Rumah Dinas Wali Kota dengan tema Satu Festival Beragam Pesona, lalu menyebut jadwal paling penting: lomba tari kreasi Sumsel Jumat jam 08.00 dan lomba fashion show wastra Palembang Jumat jam 15.00. Ia mengingatkan datang lebih awal dan pakai pakaian nyaman karena acara di ruang terbuka, lalu menutup dengan pertanyaan ringan hari apa penonton mau datang.

Output exactly one woman in one continuous shot, never a collage, split screen or reference-sheet layout. Vertical 9:16 frame, one continuous shot, twelve seconds, shot on a smartphone vlog camera with slight natural handheld sway at chest height about one and a half metres away in a three-quarter angle from her left. Location: the paved lakeside promenade of Kambang Iwak park in Palembang in the morning, calm green lake water and a low railing at frame left, leafy mature trees behind her, a row of cream festival tents and one small canvas-roofed stage being set up in the soft background and a few distant visitors blurred far away. True-to-life colours with neutral daylight white balance and no yellow or orange colour cast, realistic matte human skin with visible fine pores and natural micro texture, absolutely no waxy plastic or glossy shiny skin, zero CGI, authentic non-AI documentary look, absolutely no on-screen text, no viewfinder overlay, no camera HUD, no timestamp, no subtitles, no watermark. BEATS: from 0.0s she stands relaxed facing the lens with a warm smile and opens one hand toward the festival tents behind her while saying the festival starts today and runs until twenty-eighth November; from 4.0s she taps her palm lightly with one finger and lists the Friday morning dance-creativity contest and the Friday three o'clock wastra fashion show; from 8.0s she leans slightly forward with an amused expression, adjusts the edge of her pashmina once and advises arriving early in comfortable clothes; from 10.4s she holds a soft teasing smile for the closing question about which day the viewer will come. shots.dialogue: Kambang Iwak Fest mulai hari ini sampai dua puluh delapan November. Jumat pagi jam delapan lomba tari kreasi, sore jam tiga lomba fashion show wastra. Datang lebih awal, pakai baju nyaman. Kau mampir hari apo?

trend_sources.title: Jadwal Lengkap Kambang Iwak Fest 2026 di Palembang 26-28 November (detikSumbagsel)
trend_sources.evidence: Terbit Kamis 26 November 2026 pukul 06.00 WIB (meta pubdate 2026-11-26T06:00:13+07:00), dibaca 26 November 2026 pukul 08.12 WIB, 13 paragraf badan plus 6 butir tips. Kambang Iwak Fest 2026 digelar 26-28 November 2026 di kawasan Kambang Iwak, pelataran depan Rumah Dinas Wali Kota Palembang, bertema 'Satu Festival, Beragam Pesona'. Rangkaian acara: Festival Kuliner Halal Nusantara, Pameran Ekonomi Kreatif Palembang, lomba fashion show, lomba tari kreasi, kompetisi stand up comedy, penampilan wushu dan barongsai, parade drumband, parade budaya, fashion show wastra, dan hiburan musik. Jadwal per hari yang tertulis: Kamis 26 November musik klasik, Sandratari Duta Budaya Sumsel, band Hutan Tropis, Sanggar Awen Collection, Gankz Smokers Band, Tari Kreasi Sanggar Musi; Jumat 27 November Lomba Tari Kreasi Sumatera Selatan pukul 08.00 WIB dan Lomba Fashion Show Wastra Palembang pukul 15.00 WIB; Sabtu 28 November Lomba Stand Up Comedy Competition pukul 08.00 WIB dan Lomba Fashion Show Karnaval pukul 15.30 WIB. Tips yang dimuat: datang lebih awal, periksa jadwal kegiatan, gunakan pakaian yang nyaman, perhatikan lokasi parkir, jaga kebersihan, pantau informasi resmi penyelenggara. Artikel merujuk Instagram Pariwisata Palembang sebagai sumber jadwal; tidak menyebut harga tiket masuk.
